video_title: LEAKED: Spurs’ Voice Memo Free Agency Pitch Sent to LeBron James

quotes.speaker: Luke Kornet
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kornet pitches San Antonio as a free agency destination for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I just wanted to extend the invitation to come over here to San Antonio.
quotes.quote: I just wanted to extend the invitation to come over here to San Antonio. We have a great thing going, a lot of young talent, it's an easy place to live, tax-free. You can play alongside a generational player and a victor too. We have a guest room available if you need some time to figure things out on your end. We would be open to open our doors. It is also a great place for kids.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kornet
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kornet discusses the Spurs' roster needs and jersey number availability
quotes.excerpt: You are chasing number five and we have got five, so looking for every six for us.
quotes.quote: You are chasing number five and we have got five, so looking for every six for us. We are all in the same ballpark. My agent said that he sent it to you, but I don't know if it got lost in translation or something because I never really got a back, but if you could just sign, we will first find it, probably then sign it and send it back. I would really appreciate that.
